in_hebrew.name: Galloway
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Galloway הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Originally a Scottish surname, Galloway comes from the Old English words galla (stranger) and weg (way). The name may have been given to someone who lived near a place where strangers traveled.
